boundaries.description: Feature-scoped runtime boundary; API may validate envelopes but must not import native simulators or execute circuit compilation. Adapter access is limited to side-effect-free capability metadata; native calls/imports remain forbidden.

Proposed integration module: API may import dependency-free capability metadata; native integration functions run only in the isolated worker. Candidate library imports require selection and dependency approval.
Existing worker may call proposed adapter; must not depend on API/store/controller authority.
